messages.email_verification_source: The address nbastaki@etihad.ae appears in public aviation-industry material; Etihad's current leadership page independently confirms Dr Nadia Bastaki's present executive role: https://www.etihad.com/en/about-us/leadership
messages.subject: Executive Value Proposition | Etihad | Government, Corporate Affairs & Sustainability
messages.body:
Dear Dr. Bastaki,

I am sharing an executive value proposition prepared for Etihad Aviation Group, together with my three-page executive CV. I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities across government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance, strategic partnerships and executive advisory.

Etihad's international growth, government-facing network expansion, national economic contribution and sustainability agenda align closely with my experience. I bring practical exposure where government relations, regulation, ESG, external affairs, local-value priorities and senior executive decision-making converge.

The attached brief sets out practical areas where I could support Etihad across government and corporate affairs, international stakeholder relations, sustainability execution, strategic partnerships, reputation and executive issue management. It includes a 90-180 day action framework.

I would value a confidential discussion regarding senior opportunities where this profile could support Etihad's growth and institutional priorities. Given your leadership across People, Government and Corporate Affairs, I would also appreciate your guidance regarding the most relevant mandate within the organization.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | AGM Inc., Zijin Mining Group
+592 608 4735
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

strategic_brief.title: Executive Value Proposition for Etihad Aviation Group
strategic_brief.prepared_for_title: Chief People, Government and Corporate Affairs Officer
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Etihad's growth trajectory increases the importance of coordinated government relations, corporate affairs, sustainability, international stakeholder management and reputation readiness. My value proposition is to strengthen that institutional interface. As Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, I lead government and regulatory relations, ESG coordination, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy and executive advisory in a highly regulated multinational operating environment.
strategic_brief.company_context: Etihad is expanding its network, fleet and contribution to Abu Dhabi while advancing sustainable aviation and international government engagement. Continued growth requires disciplined coordination among aviation authorities, governments, regulators, strategic partners, communities and internal operating teams.

opportunities.title: International Government Affairs
opportunities.rationale: Network expansion depends on strong relationships with aviation authorities and public-sector stakeholders across markets.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: Support stakeholder mapping, executive briefing, relationship planning and institutional escalation across priority jurisdictions.

opportunities.title: Sustainability Execution
opportunities.rationale: Etihad's sustainability commitments require credible data, cross-functional ownership and partner coordination.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: Connect ESG commitments to operating evidence, accountable owners and executive reporting.

opportunities.title: Strategic Partnerships and Local Value
opportunities.rationale: Growth creates opportunities to align commercial partnerships with national economic and local-value priorities.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: Structure stakeholder and partnership workstreams that connect business objectives with government and development priorities.

opportunities.title: Executive Issues and Reputation
opportunities.rationale: A global airline faces reputation-sensitive operational and stakeholder issues across jurisdictions.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: Develop concise executive briefs, evidence trackers and cross-functional escalation routines.

days_0_30: Map priority government, regulatory and strategic-partner relationships.
Review sustainability evidence and issue-escalation gaps.
days_31_60: Select priority market and stakeholder pilots.
Build integrated engagement and sustainability action plans.
days_61_90: Connect commitments to evidence and executive reporting.
days_91_180: Scale effective practices across priority markets.
Measure stakeholder outcomes, issue closure and execution improvement.

background_relevance: Current Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group.
Government, regulatory, ESG, corporate affairs and executive advisory leadership.

Renewable-energy stakeholder governance and carbon-data traceability experience.
12+ years across multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations.
